metadata.method_name: G4 MeSH replication of the D2 host-entry grafting test (PPML)
metadata.description: One example per MeSH host-entry event (concept c enters PubMed-covered non-origin subfield d in year e). input = W1 features; output = Y_strict (W2 host papers by author-disjoint newcomers). predict_baseline = out-of-fold Poisson controls-only model; predict_method = + anchoring A_cont + co-transfer CT.

oos.note: grouped-by-concept 5-fold out-of-fold predictions; descriptive predictive check, not the inferential test

demo_subset.source: full_method_out.json (2,249 MeSH host-entry events, 187 concepts) + domain_d/field_d/kw5/covered50/covered70 joined from results/outcomes_mesh.parquet on (concept_id, d, e)
demo_subset.rule: concepts with 8-12 events and >= 3 events with Y_strict > 0; alternating Life-Sciences / Health-Sciences majority-host concepts, highest positive share first; whole concepts; <= 100 events

spec_models.estimator: vendored exp_7 PPML (ppml.fit via models.fit_one), offset log(n_entry_papers), CRV1 by concept
spec_models.wild_bootstrap: Kline-Santos score, Rademacher, H0 imposed; 999 (R1, R2, S1), 499 others
spec_models.thin_cell_rule: R1 retained < 30% or G < 50 -> co-primary decisive for GRAFTING/TOOLKIT

metadata.spec_prediction: IRR/SD > 1 in biomedicine, consistent with the main non-physics stratum 1.29

R1.label: primary: concept x e + d x e

R4.label: concept x 2-year bin + d x e

S3.label: placebo host d' (A_placebo in place of A_cont), co-primary

thin_cell_rule.rule: retained < 30% of events or G < 50 -> co-primary decisive

oos.note: grouped-by-concept 5-fold out-of-fold predictions; descriptive predictive check, not the inferential test

size_calibration_post_hoc.note: POST-HOC (not in the frozen spec): CRV1 over-rejects in the T3 null simulation (size 0.105 at alpha .05), so the observed R2 CRV1 p is also referred to the 200 simulated null p values
